An '''Umbaran commando''' was a rookie a part of the [[Crystal guard]]'s [[Squad One (Umbaran)|Squad One]]<ref name="Scars" /> in [[3629 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> He replaced [[Yuula]] in the squad, a fellow [[Umbaran commando]] who had gotten injured in the line of duty [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] prior. [[Veesh]] and [[Nira (Crystal guard)|Nira]] told stories to the rookie while they were transporting [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], scaring him. While Nira was in the middle of her story, the [[Eternal Alliance]] attacked the [[Train/Legends|train]], springing Squad One into action.<ref name="Scars" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Umbaran commando first appeared in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
